item.title: Indie Brief, Wednesday 30 September
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Wednesday 30 September.
Deadline reports that the Doc Talk Podcast is hitting the road this autumn with filmmakers behind several acclaimed documentaries. The series will feature makers of Union Town, Black Sunflowers, and Edward Said: Between Worlds, alongside leaders from the Camden International Film Festival.
